report:
ISLAND GOSSIP: Sea-Glass Weave is finished, 30 out of 30, and the Gallery is now hanging the prettiest cloth this side of the shallows. Teal, pale blue and a whisper of foam-white, woven in a basket weave that Pip describes as "structurally adequate", which from Pip is basically a standing ovation.

The turn tally was a perfect tie: Nova 14, Pip 14. Nova spent hers at the easel declaring that the sea has "at least forty greens, darling, and not one of them is beige." Pip spent theirs at the loom going clack, clack, clack, pausing only to say "mind your fingers" and to ask, for the ninth time, whether anyone had put the kettle on.

The Gull made 2 deliveries of sea-green dye and would like it entered into the island records that without those 2 deliveries there would be no cloth, no Gallery and possibly no sea. Seagull witnesses have been asked to confirm.

What next? Nova is already eyeing the bolt and muttering the word "scarf". Pip has hidden the scissors. We give it a day.
